Wave_Distance_Range.Description: The minimum and maximum distance NPCs will spawn away from the spawner during a wave.

Wave_Start_Time.Description: Determines when the wave will start.

Wave_Enemy_One_Type.Description: Determines the enemy type for enemy type 1 of 5.

Wave_Enemy_One_Count.Description: Determines the minimum and maximum enemy count for enemy type 1 of 5.

Wave_Enemy_One_Fan_Out.Description: Whether to spread enemy type 1 of 5 out equally across the spawn angle cone.

Wave_Enemy_One_Spawn_Angle.Description: Width of the spawn direction cone for enemy 1 of 5.

Wave_Enemy_One_Spawn_Direction.Description: Direction to spawn enemy type 1 of 5 relative to the front of the spawner.

Wave_Enemy_One_Distance_Range.Description: The minimum and maximum distance from the spawner to spawn enemy type 1 of 5.
